title: Document + Communication Automation Control
requirements: Reuse existing Document, DocumentAutomation, Communication, DocumentPack, Booking, Milestone, Approval, Task and Audit data.
Add per-booking document readiness with missing/pending/blocked/released counts and row-level exception reasons.
Add controlled communication retry that re-queues FAILED/BOUNCED records without live provider activation.
Make retry idempotent and auditable; duplicate retry requests must not create duplicate logical retries.
Block communication readiness when attached documents are not released or release control is not clear.
Add unified filters and direct job/document/remediation links in the existing Document Automation workspace.
Preserve existing role/data scope, customer privacy, document release controls and audit trail.
invariants: No database migration or new table.
No production runtime or DNS change.
Preserve CR-010 through CR-013 accepted baselines.
Free-tier only; LIVE_PROVIDERS OFF, REAL_MONEY OFF, PRODUCTION_TRAFFIC OFF.
note: Autonomous staging-only document/communication hardening; safe in-scope fixes may be applied and retested without intermediate approval.
